get.summary: DateMate Platform Rules & Client Validation Specification
get.description: Authoritative online specification of all client validation rules, media formats, languages, demographics, and schemas. Automatically updated on each backend update. Accessible at /docs/rules or /v1/docs/rules. Supports HTML view (default), JSON (?format=json), Raw Markdown (?format=raw), or file download (?download=1).

parameters.description: Format of the rules document (default: html)

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Pass 1 to download the RULES.md file directly

200.description: Platform rules document in the requested format

post.summary: Initiate user registration
post.description: Validates email & password, generates a 6-digit OTP, stores it in Redis (10m TTL), and sends a verification email via Nodemailer.

200.description: Verification code sent to email successfully

post.summary: Verify OTP code and create user account
post.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP code, creates user in PostgreSQL, initiates session, and returns JWT access + refresh tokens.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Authenticates credentials, verifies ban status, creates a new session, and returns JWT access and refresh tokens.

post.summary: Refresh expired JWT access token
post.description: Validates the refresh token, deletes the used token (token rotation), and issues a new access/refresh pair.

post.summary: Request password reset code
post.description: Generates a 6-digit reset code in Redis and dispatches it via email to the user.

200.description: Reset code sent if email exists

example.message: If the email exists, a reset code was sent

post.summary: Reset account password with code
post.description: Verifies the 6-digit code, updates user password hash, and revokes all active sessions for security.

post.summary: Get Google Play Integrity nonce
post.description: Returns a cryptographically secure random nonce string for Google Play Integrity verification.

post.summary: Sign in or register with Google OAuth
post.description: Verifies the Google OAuth ID Token in the Authorization header, creates or retrieves user, and returns JWT tokens.

401.description: Invalid or missing Google ID Token

post.summary: Sign in or register with Apple OAuth
post.description: Verifies the Apple Sign-In Identity Token in the Authorization header (or body), creates or retrieves user, and returns JWT tokens.

401.description: Invalid or missing Apple Identity Token

get.summary: Get current authenticated user profile
get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user profile details in Android schema: language, lat, lon, profileValidated, and Profile (fullName, username, phoneNumber, bio, languages, avatar, profileCompleted, Demographic, Preferences).

get.summary: Check profile completion status
get.description: Checks whether the authenticated user has completed their profile onboarding. Returns boolean status wrapped in ResponseResult envelope for mobile onboarding check.

put.summary: Update user profile (step-by-step onboarding, edit profile & gallery)
put.description: Updates user profile using Android schema (language, lat, lon, Profile: { fullName, username, phoneNumber, bio, languages, Demographic, Preferences, gallery, profilePicture }). Also supports avatar, selfie, and up to 5 gallery photo uploads (WebP/JPEG, min 1200x800, max 4096x4096, max 3MB per photo, max 15MB total).

requestBody.description: Android schema profile update payload and optional image files

200.description: Profile successfully updated with categorized response

400.description: Validation error (e.g. invalid username, age < 18 or > 80, corrupted/invalid image, resolution below 1200x800)

post.summary: Update user profile via POST (mobile client onboarding & edit profile)
post.description: Handles profile updates for mobile clients that submit via HTTP POST to /users/profile.

requestBody.description: Categorized profile update payload or mobile multipart data and optional image files

200.description: Profile successfully updated with categorized response

get.summary: Public asset route: icons
get.description: Serves UI icons and badge vector/raster assets with high-performance caching headers.

get.summary: Public asset route: images
get.description: Serves standard platform images, gallery photos, and content visuals.

get.summary: Public asset route: avatars
get.description: Serves user profile pictures and avatar photos.

get.summary: Scalable public asset route for any asset type
get.description: Dynamically serves assets for any registered asset type (e.g. /assets/icons/{filename}, /assets/images/{filename}, /assets/avatars/{filename}, banners, etc.).

get.summary: Get supported asset types and validation limits
get.description: Returns the list of all supported asset categories (icons, images, avatars, etc.) along with their allowed formats and size limits.

200.description: List of supported asset type definitions

post.summary: Upload media asset by asset type
post.description: Uploads a media file (icon, image, avatar, etc.) into its dedicated asset category. Generates a collision-proof safe filename, stores the asset decoupled from public domain, and returns the full public URL resolved with configured baseUrl.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Target asset type (e.g. icons, images, avatars)

201.description: Media successfully uploaded with full public URL

400.description: Validation failed (invalid format, magic bytes mismatch, or size exceeded)

post.summary: Upload media asset by asset type
post.description: Uploads a media file (icon, image, avatar, etc.) into its dedicated asset category. Generates a collision-proof safe filename, stores the asset decoupled from public domain, and returns the full public URL resolved with configured baseUrl.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Target asset type (e.g. icons, images, avatars)

201.description: Media successfully uploaded with full public URL

400.description: Validation failed (invalid format, magic bytes mismatch, or size exceeded)

post.summary: Upload UI icon asset
post.description: Convenience endpoint to upload icon vector or raster images (SVG, PNG, WebP).

post.summary: Upload image asset
post.description: Convenience endpoint to upload standard images and photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF).

post.summary: Upload avatar asset
post.description: Convenience endpoint to upload user profile avatar images (JPEG, PNG, WebP).

get.summary: Get questions with optional filters or by ID
get.description: Retrieves all questions with their IDs, or filters by id, type (PREFERENCES, PERSONALITY, INTERESTS, LIFESTYLE, VALUES) and language (en, fa). If no query params are provided, returns all questions with English and Farsi text. If id query param is provided, returns that specific question.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language filter (en or fa). If omitted, returns both English and Farsi texts.

404.description: Question with specified ID not found

post.summary: Create a new question (admin only)
post.description: Creates a new question with bilingual name and answer options. Each question is stored with both English and Farsi text. Requires admin role.

get.summary: Search questions by type query parameter
get.description: Searches questions by type (e.g. PREFERENCES, PERSONALITY, INTERESTS, LIFESTYLE, VALUES).

get.summary: Search/Get questions by type route parameter
get.description: Retrieves all questions of a specific type (e.g. PREFERENCES, PERSONALITY, INTERESTS, LIFESTYLE, VALUES).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Question type/category (e.g. PREFERENCES, PERSONALITY, INTERESTS, LIFESTYLE, VALUES)

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language filter (en or fa). If omitted, returns both languages.

200.description: Questions of the specified type retrieved successfully

get.summary: Get single question by route parameter ID
get.description: Retrieves a single question by its numeric ID path parameter.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language filter (en or fa). If omitted, returns both languages.

get.summary: Get all interest categories with their interests
get.description: Retrieves all interest categories, each containing a list of child interests. Matches client format: id, en, fa, icon: object, Interest: List<Interest>. Supports optional language filter (en, fa) and category ID filter.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language filter (en or fa). If omitted, returns both English and Farsi texts.

404.description: Interest category with specified ID not found

post.summary: Create a new interest category with interests (admin only)
post.description: Creates a new interest category with bilingual names and child interests. Matches client format: id, en, fa, icon, Interest: List<Interest>. Requires admin role.

get.summary: Get all interest categories with their interests
get.description: Retrieves all interest categories, each containing a list of child interests. Matches client format: id, en, fa, icon: object, Interest: List<Interest>. Supports optional language filter (en, fa) and category ID filter.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language filter (en or fa). If omitted, returns both English and Farsi texts.

404.description: Interest category with specified ID not found

post.summary: Create a new interest category with interests (admin only)
post.description: Creates a new interest category with bilingual names and child interests. Matches client format: id, en, fa, icon, Interest: List<Interest>. Requires admin role.

get.summary: Get a single interest category by ID
get.description: Retrieves a single interest category with its child interests by numeric ID.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language filter (en or fa). If omitted, returns both languages.

get.summary: Get a single interest category by ID
get.description: Retrieves a single interest category with its child interests by numeric ID.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language filter (en or fa). If omitted, returns both languages.

get.description: Retrieves the 4 core summary counters: total platform users, online users, unverified pending selfies, and unanswered support tickets.

401.description: Missing/invalid token or insufficient administrator privileges

post.summary: Ban/block a user account with duration or permanent ban
post.description: Moderation endpoint allowing admins to ban a user for specific duration (in hours, e.g. 24, 168) or permanently (null). Automatically invalidates active sessions.

401.description: Missing/invalid token or insufficient administrator privileges

post.summary: Unban/unblock a previously banned user
post.description: Removes the ban from a user account by setting bannedUntil to null.

401.description: Missing/invalid token or insufficient administrator privileges

get.description: Retrieves the queue of pending selfie reviews with user avatarUrl and selfieUrl for admin inspection.

post.description: Approves the user identity selfie verification, sets User.profileValidated = true, and fires a PROFILE_VERIFIED notification.

post.description: Rejects the user identity selfie verification, clears the selfieUrl, sets profileValidated = false, and creates a notification explaining the rejection reason.
